name: HmongTown Marketplace
neighborhoodOrCity: Frogtown / North End, St. Paul (217 Como Ave.)
whatItIs: Indoor and summer outdoor market, opened 2004, listing over 125 stores and 11 restaurants.
evidence: Own site shows hours and temporary hours since Jan. 17, 2026. MPR/Sahan Journal, Oct. 7, 2026, reports a foreclosure suit and a Nov. 24 receiver hearing; vendors were operating at a Sept. 30 visit. It could close.

name: Hmong Village Shopping Center
neighborhoodOrCity: East Side, St. Paul (1001 Johnson Pkwy.)
whatItIs: Large indoor market and food court; a June 2026 guide counts over 250 vendors.
evidence: Woven, June 30, 2026, describes it as open daily. Hmong Museum lists its gallery there with current weekend hours.

name: Mai's Papaya
whatItIs: Food court stall known for papaya salad; cash only.
evidence: Listed as a current stall in a June 30, 2026 guide. Own page not found.

name: Hmong Express Cuisine
whatItIs: Stall known for mortar-pounded papaya salad and grilled meats.
evidence: Listed as a current stall in a June 30, 2026 guide; the guide warns that some market restaurants have offered takeout only.

name: Hmoob Kitchen
whatItIs: Stall serving Hmong classics, including papaya salad with kapoon.
evidence: Listed as a current stall in a June 30, 2026 guide.

name: Vinai
whatItIs: Chef Yia Vang's Hmong restaurant.
evidence: Own site lists current hours and reservations; on Mpls.St.Paul Magazine's March 2026 best restaurants list.

name: Union Hmong Kitchen
whatItIs: Yia Vang's earlier venture. Its restaurant sites have closed; it appears at the State Fair.
evidence: Own site says Uptown and North Loop locations closed and to find it at the State Fair. Sahan Journal, Aug. 27, 2026, reviewed its Hmong corndog at the 2026 fair, so the brand operates as a seasonal vendor.

name: Diane's Place
whatItIs: Hmong American chef Diane Moua's restaurant, serving breakfast, lunch and dinner.
evidence: Own site modified Sept. 26, 2026; on Mpls.St.Paul Magazine's March 2026 best restaurants list.

name: Marc Heu Patisserie Paris
neighborhoodOrCity: St. Paul (156 Dale St. N) and Minneapolis (3509 W. 44th St.)
whatItIs: Patisserie by French-born Hmong pastry chef Marc Heu and Gaosong Heu.
evidence: Own site lists both addresses and undated summer hours; no dated 2025 or 2026 item seen.

name: SoYen Desserts
whatItIs: Bakery by Yen Fang blending Italian, Thai and Hmong influences.
evidence: Own site shows late-October notices for Halloween donuts, Nov. 1 and Nov. 6 service changes.

name: Billy's Hmong Shop
whatItIs: Handsewn Hmong funeral garments, spirit money and funeral items; partner to North Memorial Health.
evidence: Sahan Journal, Aug. 26, 2026, describes the current shop.

name: Pan Asian Center
whatItIs: Center identified in 2025 as owned by Toua Xiong; hosted 2026 community events.
evidence: Hosted a benefit concert in March 2026; the foreclosure suit names the Sears property, listed as Hmongtown 2. Current operation not confirmed from its own page.

name: Rainbow Garden Farm
whatItIs: Hmong couple's flower and vegetable farm with rice field, open to visitors since 2023.
evidence: Sahan Journal, Oct. 27, 2025; owners hoped to stay open the next year, and 2026 status was not found.

name: Hmong American Farmers Association
whatItIs: Farm of 150-plus acres, CSA and wholesale produce from Hmong farming families.
evidence: Own site lists a Thanksgiving CSA and a May 18, 2026 blog post.

name: Moua Law Office PA
neighborhoodOrCity: East Side, St. Paul (261 Ruth St. N)
whatItIs: Firm with attorneys bilingual in English and Hmong; auto accident, criminal and family law.
evidence: Own site carries a 2024 copyright; no 2025 or 2026 item seen.

name: Mai N. Moua Law Office
whatItIs: Immigration practice; managing attorney quoted on deportations to Laos.
evidence: Named as a current firm in Sahan Journal, Oct. 17, 2025; own site not opened.

name: Hmong Funeral Home
neighborhoodOrCity: West Side, St. Paul (199 Plato Blvd. E)
whatItIs: Funeral home listed with license 1266.
evidence: Directory listing with no date; own Facebook page showed only its title.

name: Hmong Funeral Home (former)
whatItIs: Opened 1994; for a time the only funeral home of its kind in the Twin Cities.
evidence: MPR News, July 31, 2008: the owner closed it in late 2007.

name: Hmong Times
whatItIs: Hmong community newspaper and event calendar.
evidence: Site carries 2026 stories, including a 2026 State Fair article and events through Nov. 2026, with a 2026 copyright.

name: 3HmongTV
whatItIs: Hmong-language TV and YouTube outlet.
evidence: Working site but no date on the page.

name: HMOOB.TV
whatItIs: Hmong news and video site.
evidence: Article dated Oct. 6, 2026. Location not stated; included as a media source.

name: Minnesota Hmong Chamber of Commerce
whatItIs: Chamber founded in 1996 per MNopedia.
evidence: Website showed only a placeholder when checked.

name: Little Mekong district and night market
whatItIs: Pan-Asian district presented by the Asian Economic Development Association.
evidence: Own page's latest dates are for June 2025; 2026 night market not confirmed.

name: United Hmong Family, Inc.
whatItIs: Nonprofit producing New Year, J4 and the Hmong Minnesota Pageant.
evidence: Own site lists office hours and the 2026 New Year dates.
